title: APM public request intake contract
description: Untrusted public form input for the eventual Apps Script/Google Sheet adapter. This is a contract only, not an Apps Script deployment.

lga.description: Required location field. The server must match it against its supplied authoritative 20-LGA configuration and return the configured spelling.

ward_code.description: Required location field. When an approved ward map is configured, the code must belong to the selected LGA.

address.description: Required free-text location details. It is private and must not be published.

category.description: Required single primary category. Only a configured subset of these exact values may be enabled.

details.description: Required private free text. Surrounding whitespace may be removed, but submitted meaning and wording must otherwise be preserved.

consent.description: Required affirmative consent. Only the JSON boolean true is valid; missing, false, string, numeric, and malformed values are rejected.

name.description: Optional private follow-up name. It must never be logged, echoed in errors, or published.

phone.description: Optional private follow-up phone. The shape permits 7 to 15 digits and common spacing, parenthesis, and hyphen formatting. Normalization removes formatting without inferring a country code.

email.description: Optional private follow-up email. Only a conservative address shape is accepted; the domain is lowercased and the local part is preserved.

website.description: Hidden optional honeypot field. When included, it must be an empty string and must never be shown to people.

submitted_at.description: Optional timezone-aware client timestamp. If supplied, the server must pass an explicit timezone-aware now value and reject timestamps older than 24 hours or more than 5 minutes in the future.

request_id.allocation: The endpoint must allocate the year and sequence. The pure validator includes an ID only when the server supplies request_id or an explicit request_id_generator.

created_at.allocation: Derived only from an explicit timezone-aware server time supplied by the endpoint.

x-normalized-private-record.privacy: Private-only storage. Optional contact fields require an owner-approved retention policy and are never public.

request_id.description: Server-generated non-sensitive request tracking reference. It is not an official voter ID. The browser displays this value only after strict validation.

x-endpoint-response.note: The endpoint must return JSON with request_id only. It must not return private request fields or contact details.

x-public-projection.note: This function is a fixed field projection, not a public aggregate. Aggregation must publish approved counts and reporting dates only and must apply small-count suppression.

x-safety-rules: Do not collect or request an official voter ID, registered voter number, or any equivalent identity credential.
A request_id is only a non-sensitive request tracking reference and must not be described as an official voter ID.
The endpoint must repeat every validation rule and must not rely on browser validation.
Unknown payload fields, malformed consent, invalid LGA/ward pairs, invalid category values, honeypot values, control characters, and invalid contact shapes are rejected.
If the approved ward map is not configured, a nonblank ward_code may pass pure validation only with ward_map_required_before_production; the endpoint must block production use.
Raw requests, private contact fields, Google Sheet data, Apps Script source, credentials, and validation values must not be committed, logged, or placed in docs.
Request submissions are campaign input only and are not verified needs, achievements, promises, evidence, or outcome measurements.
